pilot.requires: accepted screening records and selected exact routes

tasks.reason: no controlled compaction evidence; one read and one mutation slot do not qualify either route with two repetitions

pilot.fixed_result_reviews: Replace pilot slots with P3 T2/T4 reviews of hash-bound snapshots; additional slots need revised approval, never exceed 18.

ablation.reason: No measured live baseline bottleneck; no extension selected or installed. Pair against existing same-task baseline records. Package/peer/SDK/license/telemetry/data-path/headless audit required before a variant can be enabled.

notes: Dollar figures are unapproved estimates, not an enforced provider cap.
GLM replaces a comparison slot or requires a revised approval.
Astra is a justified escalation only; Cursor and Antigravity are separate harness comparisons and excluded.
No automatic pilot promotion or ablation starts.
